requirementname: Create a New Task As a user, I want to create a new task so that it can be added to the project timeline. Initiate creation of a new task Set initial properties for the new task The system should allow users to initiate the creation of a new task from any selected node in the Gantt chart. Upon creation, the new task should be added as a child node under the currently selected node in the project hierarchy. The newly created task should have default properties set (e.g., start date based on the current view state).

Delete Tasks As a user, I want to be able to delete selected tasks from the Gantt chart so that they are removed from the project timeline and related data. Select multiple tasks Confirm task deletion Remove tasks from the hierarchy The system should display a confirmation dialog before deleting tasks. Selected tasks must be removed from both the Gantt chart and underlying data structures. The user should receive feedback if no tasks are selected for deletion.

Maintain Task Properties The system shall allow users to modify various properties of a task, including its duration and name. Modify task duration Set task name Users can update the duration of a task by setting it through an appropriate method. Users can change the name of a task by updating the corresponding property.

Add and Remove Subtasks Users can add or remove a task as a subtask of another task in the Gantt chart. Add subtask Remove subtask When adding a subtask, the selected task becomes the parent and the new task is inserted as its child. When removing a subtask, the task is detached from its current parent and reinserted into the tree structure if necessary.

Set Task as Milestone The system shall allow users to mark a task as a milestone. Mark tasks as milestones Users can set any task as a milestone or remove the milestone status. Setting a task as a milestone updates its metadata accordingly.

Create a New Person Resource The system shall allow users to create new person resources within the project. Allow creation of human resource entries Display default role for newly created persons When a user creates a new person, the system should set their default role A dialog for entering person details should be displayed upon creating a new person The newly created person should be added to the project resources after validation

Delete Resources As a user, I can delete selected resources from the project to update resource allocation. Select multiple resources Confirm deletion of resources Remove resources from the project The system should display a confirmation dialog before deleting resources. Selected resources should be removed from the project's resource list. The UI should update to reflect the removal of deleted resources.

Maintain Resource Properties The system shall allow users to modify and manage properties of resources, including their assignments and custom fields. Allow modification of resource names, emails, phone numbers, default roles, and assignment-specific roles. Support adding, deleting, and managing custom columns for resource properties. Users can update the name, email, phone number, and default role of a resource through the interface. Users can add or remove custom fields related to resources via the UI. Changes in resource assignments trigger updates to the display of those assignments. Deleting a custom column removes it from both the data model and the user interface.

Add/Remove Task Links As a user, I can add or remove dependencies between tasks in the Gantt chart. Can create task dependencies Can delete task dependencies The system should allow users to select multiple tasks and establish dependencies between them. The system should enable users to clear all existing dependencies for a selected task.

Add/Remove Resources from Task Dependencies The user can add or remove resources to/from task dependencies in the Gantt chart. Add resource to a task dependency Remove resource from a task dependency When adding a resource, it should be correctly assigned to the task and update the project's resource assignments. When removing a resource, its assignment to the task should be removed and the project's resource assignments should be updated accordingly.

Change Task Duration and End Date Users can manually adjust the start and end times of a task, which triggers recalculation of related activities. Adjust task duration Set task end date Recalculate task activities When a user changes the start or end time of a task, the system recalculates the task's activities based on the new dates. The system updates the task's length and end date when manually adjusted by the user.

Automatically Adjust Task Begin and End Times Based on Dependencies When task dependencies change, the system automatically updates the begin and end times of affected tasks to maintain consistency with their new dependencies. Triggers automatic adjustment of task schedules when a dependency is added or modified. Updates the start and end dates of tasks based on their updated dependencies. The system recalculates the earliest start and latest end dates for selected tasks whenever a new dependency is added or an existing one changes. Dependencies between tasks are honored, ensuring that task schedules remain consistent with their dependencies without manual intervention.

Automatically Adjust Task Begin/End Times Based on Subtasks When subtask times are changed, the parent task's start and end times should automatically adjust to reflect these changes. Recalculate the duration of tasks based on their subtasks' durations Notify listeners when a task schedule is changed The start and end times of a parent task are updated whenever any of its subtasks have their start or end times modified. A TaskScheduleEvent is fired to notify all registered listeners about the change in the task's schedule.

Prevent Circular Dependencies Ensure that tasks cannot depend on themselves or form a circular dependency graph. Validate task dependencies Detect and prevent loops in the dependency graph The system should reject any attempt to create a dependency where the dependent task is the same as the dependee task. The system should detect and prevent the creation of circular dependencies by ensuring that no task depends on another task that ultimately leads back to it.

Show Critical Path The system shall display the critical path of tasks in the Gantt chart when the user requests it. Recalculate and display critical path Update task status based on criticality When the 'Calculate Critical Path' action is triggered, the system recalculates and highlights the critical path of all tasks in the Gantt chart. The critical path is visually distinguished from non-critical paths in the Gantt chart. If a task's end date is before today and its completion percentage is less than 100%, it is marked as delayed, with critical delays being highlighted more prominently.

Manage Holiday and Vacation Day Settings Users can add, remove, and manage holiday and vacation days within the Gantt project calendar. Add holidays Remove holidays Set week day types Define vacation periods The system should allow users to specify public holidays via an external URL. Users can set specific dates as vacation days by defining a start and end date range. Weekend settings cannot be changed in the Always Working Time Calendar. Holiday and vacation day definitions must accurately reflect their duration and overlap with other calendar events.

Show Resource Utilization Display a list of resources that are underutilized or overutilized. Identify and display underused resources Identify and display overused resources The system should calculate the utilization of each resource based on their maximum allowed units per day. Resources with usage below the maximum allowed units are marked as underutilized. Resources with usage above the maximum allowed units are marked as overutilized.

Initialize Chart Component The system shall initialize a chart component with project data, UI facade, and zoom manager to enable interactive chart display. Initialize chart component Set up state listeners for view changes Configure mouse interactions The chart component should be initialized with the provided project, UI facade, and zoom manager. State change events should trigger a repaint of the chart. Zoom changes should propagate to the implementation layer. Mouse interactions should be properly configured.
